sections.description:
Originality.ai AI Detection for WordPress

Verified AI Detector with 4.2/5 on TrustPilot ★★★★

AI Content Detection for WordPress

The Originality.ai plugin provides AI content detection directly in your WordPress dashboard. Scan your content – from a single post to your entire website – for AI-generated text.

Originality.ai works with content generated by popular large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, GPT-4, Claude, Llama, Gemini and others. It also detects paraphrase plagiarism, a common method used to bypass AI or plagiarism detection.

The Originality.ai plugin offers 3 AI detection models:

  • Lite – High accuracy with low false positive rate, allows for light AI editing with tools like Grammarly. Suitable for academic use and environments requiring minimal false positives.
  • Turbo – High accuracy detection that is robust against common bypass methods and does not allow for AI editing. Suitable for strict no-AI policies.
  • Multi-language – AI detection across 15 languages.

For guidance on using the tool and interpreting scores, please watch our tutorial videos.

Try our free AI checker

How Does Originality.ai Compare to Other AI Content Detectors?

Originality.ai provides reliable AI content detection with a focus on minimizing false positives. The tool can identify paraphrased content, whether originally AI-generated or human-written.

See our comparative study analyzing AI detection capabilities – See Case Study.

Originality.ai offers a comprehensive suite of content QA tools to help you maintain content quality control.

Key Features

  • AI Detection: Identify AI-generated content across major language models
  • WordPress Integration: Scan posts directly from your dashboard
  • Bulk Scanning: Process multiple posts simultaneously
  • Multiple Detection Models: Choose from Lite, Turbo, or Multi-language models
  • Shareable Reports: Export and share scan results
  • Real-time Scanning: Get immediate feedback on content
  • Post-Level Results: View scores in WordPress post lists
  • Gutenberg Support: Scan from the block editor
  • Detection History: Access all previous scan results
  • LLM Coverage: Works with ChatGPT, GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and others

Try our free Plagiarism checker

Who Should Use Originality.ai?

AI content detection is suitable for anyone who publishes content on the web or needs to verify their content for AI. Designed for:

  • WordPress sites
  • Website owners
  • Content marketers
  • Digital marketers
  • Online publishers
  • Writers
  • Editors
  • Content Agencies
  • SEO professionals
  • Bloggers
  • eCommerce Store Owners
  • Niche Sites
  • Businesses
  • Local Businesses

Pro Plans vs Enterprise Plans

Getting Started

To use the Originality.ai WordPress plugin, you need an Originality.ai account. You can download the plugin without one, but scans require an active account with credits.

To set up an account, visit our sign up page.

If you already have an Originality.ai account, you’ll be prompted to log in after installing the WordPress plugin. Once connected, you can start scanning your content.

Installation Instructions
To install from the WordPress directory, go to the Add plugin page and search for “Originality.ai.” Click “Install now” to install the plugin. After installation, go to “Installed plugins” and click “Activate” to activate the Originality.ai plugin.

Once installed, you’ll be prompted to sign in to your Originality.ai account. After signing in, you can start scanning your content.

Usage

After installing the plugin, visit Settings > Originality.ai. Connect your Originality.ai account by entering your login details and choose your default AI detection model. Save your settings to begin scanning.

On your “Posts” page, you’ll see a new column named “Originality.ai Score” where you can view recent AI scores.

To scan an individual post, you have two options:

  1. Click “Start new scan” under the “Originality.ai Score” column for a specific post.
  2. Or select a post, open the WordPress editor, and select “Click to Scan” in the right block under “Originality.ai Score.”

In the WordPress editor, you can select your Originality.ai Model. We offer 3 models: Turbo, Lite, and Multilanguage. You can change models and run multiple scans to compare results. For more information about our models, read our detailed description.

To scan multiple pages at once, use the “Start AI scan for all posts” button to scan your entire website efficiently.

After running scans, you can view results directly in the app, where you can also access additional features like plagiarism detection, fact-checking, and grammar checking. You can securely share scans by selecting “Copy link of results”.

The scan result shows the confidence score indicating whether content is likely AI-generated or Original.

You can view all lifetime scan results on the Originality.ai settings page and share results with clients or writers.

Research on AI detection accuracy shows Originality.ai performing well in comparative studies. To read detailed analysis, you can see our full study.

Studies and research demonstrating detection capabilities:

Why Choose Our Model?

Our AI detection model was developed with several key principles:

  1. Larger Model: We use a comprehensive model that requires significant compute resources per scan, which enables higher accuracy.

sections.faq:
Can I See Previous Scans?

Yes, all scans are stored for later retrieval or sharing. Complete removal of your account and data is available upon request.

Can Originality.ai Detect ChatGPT Content?

Yes, Originality.ai can detect ChatGPT content.

Can Google Detect and Penalize AI Generated Content?

We completed a correlation study of 20,000 web pages and identified a correlation between Originality score and Google search result ranking, potentially indicating that AI content may perform differently in Google than Original content.

Does the WordPress Plugin Have Plagiarism Checking?

The current version of the Originality.ai WordPress plugin focuses on AI detection. However, plagiarism checking, fact-checking, and grammar features can be accessed through the app. Simply click “View Scan” to access these additional features on your scans.

How Does AI Detection Work?

Our artificial intelligence uses supervised learning with multiple models including a modified BERT model to predict if content is AI or Original. Our AI has been trained on millions of records of both AI and Original content to distinguish between the two.

Does Originality.ai Provide Paraphrase Detection?

Yes, Originality.ai’s AI has been trained to detect if content has been paraphrased with tools like Quillbot. Content run through paraphrasing tools, regardless of whether it started as AI or human-written, will be identified as AI-generated in most cases.

What Languages Does the AI Detector Work For?

Originality.ai’s AI detection is currently trained and tested for English language content. Plagiarism checking works across multiple languages.

Do you Have a Plagiarism Checking and AI Detection API?

Yes, we have a robust API integrated into content operations platforms for major publishers, writing agencies, and marketplaces. Full documentation is available in the backend. For unique use cases or volume inquiries, please contact us.

What Do AI Detection Scores Mean?

AI detection scores represent the confidence level that text was AI-generated or Original. They are not measures of the amount of AI versus Original content in a given text.

We recommend not applying strict rules when evaluating AI scores. If a writer consistently has high Originality scores but then shows a higher AI score on one article, this could be a false positive requiring further investigation.

Here is guidance on interpreting AI scores for writers.

What Can Cause False Positives?

False positives in AI detection do occur. Different factors can affect detection accuracy for each tool.

Tips for minimizing false positives:

  • A detection score of 60% Original and 40% AI means 60% confidence the content is Original, not that 60% was Original and 40% was AI.
  • Editing AI-written content is detected as AI content (true positive, not false positive).
  • Having AI edit your work is detected as AI content (true positive, not false positive).
  • Any AI involvement in content creation can cause the entire article to be flagged as AI.
  • Heavy use of AI writing tools for outlines, edits, or optimization can increase AI scores.
  • Unusual formatting can reduce detector accuracy.
  • Shorter text (under 100 words) results in less accurate detection. We recommend at least 100 words for scanning.

How Does Originality.ai Compare to Other AI Content Detectors?

Originality.ai provides reliable AI content detection with low false positive rates. The tool also identifies paraphrased content.

See the complete comparative study – See Case Study.

How Accurate is Originality.ai AI Content Detection Tool?

When tested on recent OpenAI models, Originality.ai Lite demonstrated high accuracy rates.

What is AI Generated Text?

AI-generated text is content written by Artificial Intelligence (AI), specifically using Large Language Models (LLMs). The primary example is OpenAI’s ChatGPT, which uses NLP Models (GPT-3, GPT-3.5 and GPT-4) to understand prompts and provide written responses.

For AI text detection purposes, we flag content that has been meaningfully changed by AI, consistent with plagiarism definitions: “Presenting work or ideas from another source as your own.”

Light editing with tools like Grammarly is NOT considered AI-generated.

Reference for what we identify as AI or Original:

  • AI Generated and Not Edited = AI Generated Text
  • AI Generated and Human Edited = AI Generated Text
  • AI Outline, Human Written and heavily AI Edited = AI Generated Text
  • AI Research and Human Written = Original Human-Generated
  • Human Written and Edited with Grammarly = Original Human-Generated
  • Human Written and Edited = Original Human-Generated
